scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @revival/storage-runtime test && pnpm --filter @revival/storage-service test && pnpm build && pnpm check:e2e-core && pnpm check:e2e-heavy
scripts.check:e2e-core: pnpm --filter @revival/web exec playwright test --grep-invert ''10,000 legacy records|3,000 records complete|10,000 records complete''
scripts.check:e2e-heavy: pnpm --filter @revival/web exec playwright test task8e-independent-acceptance.spec.ts --grep ''10,000 legacy records|3,000 records complete|10,000 records complete'' --workers=1
